_comment: Co-op test presets. Start one from the launch screen buttons, F8 -> Coop Test, or TMC_COOP_TEST=<name> ./tmc_pc. warp = area,room,x,y,layer (pixels from the room's top-left corner, 0x hex allowed; layer 1 = bottom layer). all_items / mid_game_flags default to true.

presets.name: enemies
presets.description: Deepwood Shrine, pillar room: six Sluggulas. Fighting, hits, knockback.

presets.name: buttons
presets.description: Deepwood Shrine: a floor button next to Link. Step on it and off.

presets.name: push
presets.description: Deepwood Shrine: block statues around a pressure plate. Push and pull.

presets.name: transition
presets.description: Deepwood Shrine: Link stands in the open south doorway. One step down moves to the next room.

presets.name: portal
presets.description: Western Wood (Hyrule Field): a portal stump right above Link. Step on it and press R (S key).

presets.name: npc
presets.description: Link's house, the workshop: Smith is in the room. Walk up and talk (A, X key).

presets.name: pots
presets.description: Deepwood Shrine, pot room: eight pots. Lift (R; player 2: H key), carry, throw.

presets.name: grabbers
presets.description: Cave by Lake Hylia: four Like Likes and a Rupee Like. They grab and swallow whichever Link they catch.

presets.name: shooters
presets.description: Hyrule Field, eastern hills: Octoroks spit rocks at the nearest Link.

presets.name: boss-chuchu
presets.description: Deepwood Shrine, boss room: Big ChuChu. The boss attacks and picks the nearest Link.

presets.name: boss-gleerok
presets.description: Cave of Flames, in front of the boss door: go up through the big door and the Gleerok fight starts as in a normal game. Fireballs fly at the nearest Link; only player 1 can stand on its body.
